note: The verified licence of every package a requirements file of the default install names (SDD section 8, CT-005), plus the optional TabPFN extra. A package is added here, with the licence read from its own metadata or repository, in the commit that adds it to a requirements file. scripts/check_licences.py fails on a requirement missing from this table and on any AGPL, GPL or BSL (Business Source License) licence; with --installed it reads the metadata of every distribution installed in the running interpreter, direct or transitive.

numpy.licence: BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0

scipy.source: package metadata (License classifier: BSD License), scipy 1.18.1

optbinning.source: package metadata (License-Expression), optbinning 1.0.0; depends on ortools (Apache 2.0) and ropwr (Apache 2.0)

interpret-core.source: repository interpretml/interpret LICENSE (MIT), dossier 04 section K; the wheel's metadata carries no licence field

catboost.source: package metadata (License: Apache License, Version 2.0), catboost 1.2.10

openpyxl.source: package metadata (License, classifier OSI Approved :: MIT License), openpyxl 3.1.5; reads the EBA/ESRB 2025 macro-financial scenario workbook of case C18

pypdf.source: package metadata (License-Expression), pypdf 6.19.0; reads the arXiv PDFs of case C05

arch.source: package metadata (License-Expression), arch 8.0.0, installed by the engine extra riskvalidation[market] for C11 and C13

torch.licence: Apache-2.0 AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND BSL-1.0 AND MIT
torch.source: package metadata (License-Expression), torch 2.14.1+cpu; BSL-1.0 is the Boost Software License; optional extra

tabpfn.source: package metadata (License-Expression), tabpfn 9.1.0; the v2 weights are under the Prior Labs License v1.1 (Apache 2.0 plus attribution); optional extra
